name: Data Analyzer: page settings file turns off usage statistics sent to an outside service
objective: Shows that the page's settings file tells the page framework (Streamlit) not to send usage statistics from users' browsers to an outside service. This is a check of the settings file, not of a running page.
precondition: The repository's page settings file (.streamlit/config.toml) is present. No network.

steps.action: Read the page settings file and look up the usage statistics setting in its browser section.
steps.expected: The setting gatherUsageStats is present and is false.

name: Data Analyzer: every page start command turns off usage statistics
objective: Shows that both ways the container starts the page (with and without a base address path) pass the option that turns usage statistics off. This is a check of the start script's text, not of a running container.
precondition: The container start script (entrypoint.sh) is present. No network.

steps.action: Read the start script and find every command that starts the page.
steps.expected: At least two start commands are found, and each one contains the option --browser.gatherUsageStats=false.

name: Data Analyzer: page deployment template turns off usage statistics
objective: Shows that the deployment template for the page sets the environment setting that turns usage statistics off, so a deployed page does not depend on the settings file alone.
precondition: The page's deployment template (deploy/aca/containerapp-ui.yaml) is present. No network.

steps.action: Read the deployment template and collect the environment settings of the page container.
steps.expected: STREAMLIT_BROWSER_GATHER_USAGE_STATS is set to the text false.
